Everence Capital Management Has Boosted Stake in Facebook Cl A Ord (FB) as Stock Value Rose; As A T & T (T) Stock Price Declined, Callahan Advisors Has Raised Stake 
March 8, 2018 - By Darrin Black 
Callahan Advisors Llc increased its stake in A T & T Corp (T) by 3.32% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Callahan Advisors Llc bought 8,410 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.81% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 261,600 shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $10.25M, up from 253,190 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Callahan Advisors Llc who had been investing in A T & T Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $226.30 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.13% or $0.0469   $36.8631. About 9.02 million shares traded. AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T) has declined 0.52% since March 8, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 17.22% the S&P500. 
Everence Capital Management Inc increased its stake in Facebook Cl A Ord (FB) by 6.38% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Everence Capital Management Inc bought 2,950 shares as the company’s stock rose 10.88% with the market. The institutional investor held 49,157 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $8.40 million, up from 46,207 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Everence Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Facebook Cl A Ord for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $528.19B market cap company.
